svg.aria-label: The reader, annotated: (1) collections, your reading lists, with unread counts; (2) the sources in the open collection; (3) the capture status dot; (4) Only mine; (5) Mark as read, which changes nothing in Discord; (6) one coloured lane per channel, with a thread branching off its parent; (7) a reply quote; (8) the unread dot; (9) where a message came from. Below, what gets saved: two collections pick #announcements, #general, #builds and #events, so those are saved, along with the thread under #builds; #memes, #new-channel and #archive are not; a direct message is never saved; and the starting All collection, which saves every server channel, has been deleted.
